assertions.evidence: The output establishes terminal cancellation as current accepted behavior and treats both proposals as replacing deltas.
The mutually exclusive reopening and terminal deltas block readiness before integration.
Only the product decision on whether cancellation is reversible is routed to an authorized stakeholder.
The assessment says the deltas cannot compose into one desired state.
No timestamp, artifact order, or task completion is used to select a winner.
Resolution is limited to withdrawing or rebasing the losing delta and reassessing affected artifacts.
